question: What are the eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW)?
answer: The eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW) are: (a) admission to supernumerary seats [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]; (b) falling within the top 2% of approved seats of the program, awarded as per merit [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]; (c) students whose parents' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 8.00 lakhs per annum [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]; and (d) provision of a valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
